summary.intent: Land review fixes on measurement PRs #318 and #324 (and related stale findings on shape detection), then start a read-only, multi-phase defect sweep of the caliper repo using callisto's findings as hypotheses, beginning with a Phase 0 hotspot table.
summary.outcome: Sample worker fixed all 10 findings on #318 and corrected #324's premise (Storybook defaults to collapseInheritedProps 'none'); both branches were pushed and #324's body updated. The four shape-detection findings on caliper/65 were found stale, not bugs, but the attempt to resolve them in Entire was denied. Phase 0 scanner was written and mostly run, with two sections needing a rerun, and no sweep agents have started.

repo: Storybook addon (packages/storybook/src/provider.ts:69) defaults collapseInheritedProps to 'none', while CLI, NAPI and Vite plugin default to 'dependencies'; measurements must state which config they describe.
Entire does not re-evaluate findings after a fix lands in the same PR, so findings can show as open and 'current' when already fixed (bfb51b97 in PR #270).
Shared helpers (propsTypeOf, exportName, schema-2 prop merge, normComponent, pathKey) now live in checker-components.ts and canonical.ts; agent-truth.ts had a third copy that was removed.
The core library has 54 clippy::indexing_slicing hits, all provably safe; about 17 rely on a guard several lines above and could use let-else slice patterns or reasoned #[allow].
PR stacking: #324 is stacked on #318 and #326 on #325; merge each stack bottom-up. #291 should not merge until the 0.9.0 release is cleared.

code.finding: Addon defaults collapseInheritedProps to 'none', so it already lists all inherited props and has zero layer-only props.
Holds the tests added by bfb51b97 covering the four shape-detection fixes (forwardRef type args, alias evidence, tagged factory promotion).

workflow: Reproduce a review finding against current main before calling it a bug; reading finding text and repeating it led to a wrong claim.
Write failing tests first for review findings so each fix is shown to address a real failure.
Write-actions on external services like Entire can be blocked by the permission check; surface the exact command for the user instead of trying other routes.
Phase 0 scripts need careful quoting and noise filtering (fixtures, unwrap_or) or hotspot rankings and some sections come back empty or misleading.

friction: Permission check denied resolving the four stale Entire findings.
Initial Phase 0 ranking was dominated by fixtures and noisy unwrap_or( counts, requiring a rerun.
Quoting bugs in the Phase 0 script left package test scripts and benchmark invocation sections empty, needing a manual redo.
Earlier assistant claim that the four shape-detection findings were real bugs was wrong and had to be retracted.
The earlier claim that Storybook can't show layer-only prop types was wrong and had to be retracted in docs, code comment and PR text.
open_items: Get user go-ahead to resolve the four stale findings on caliper/65 with commit bfb51b97.
Show the user the Phase 0 table and get approval before starting Phase 1+ sweep agents.
Decide whether to create trails G, H and I for sweep findings, and the exclude choice (document and warn now vs real globs).
User decision on whether they want the reusable checklist and review prompt for other repos.
Decide on the 0.9.0 GitHub Release before merging #291.
t172-modes (#320's 8 findings) and t192-collapse workers are still running; their results are pending.
Merge #318, #320 and #321–#326 bottom-up once CI is read and agent review re-runs.
Consider an indexing_slicing lint ratchet to make guard invariants explicit.
